verdict.rationale: Zep exposes API/SDK operations for adding messages/data (thread.add_messages), searching the graph (semantic+BM25), and deleting nodes/edges, and also offers a Memory MCP Server so an agent's tool-calling client can invoke these operations mid-conversation. However, evidence doesn't show an explicit 'update memory' API distinct from add/delete, nor confirmation that the MCP server exposes full CRUD (add/search/update/delete) as agent-callable tools rather than just read/connect access. missing for 10: explicit update-memory API/tool, confirmation MCP server exposes add/search/delete as agent-invokable tools (not just connection), independent hands-on evidence of an agent autonomously performing these operations mid-conversation.
